rationale: The fall and fractured wrist are a sudden injury during the covered trip (June 22 to July 1, 2026), and the itemized bill ($3,800.00) and medical report are on file, with no pre-existing condition, adventure sport or other exclusion under Section 7 and Section 9 of the wording. Under Section 10 and manual section 6, the $3,800 eligible amount less the $50 Premium deductible gives $3,750, which is above the $1,000 payout limit in manual section 3 and so needs claims handler sign-off before payment.
